headline: The search teacher, as shipped, IS the heuristic: 120/120 identical actions across four maps and zero takeovers. Its thresholds are mis-calibrated far above the leaf-margin range, not its mechanism. Recalibrated it differs in 71% of decisions and never worsens its own objective, but it cannot run as an online policy at all.

tasks.title: Make the search proxy a testable teacher
tasks.verdict: UNQUALIFIED as shipped; QUALIFIED as an OFFLINE label source after calibration; UNQUALIFIED as an online policy
tasks.notes: Shipped config agrees with a plain HeuristicAI on 120/120 decisions over four maps, always via FALLBACK_TO_HEURISTIC; median leaf margin 0-75 against a 1,200 takeover threshold, so the takeover branch is unreachable. Forcing takeover changes the action in 17/24 decisions, so this is a threshold defect, not a dead mechanism. Calibrated (topK 64, forced takeover), the paired leaf comparison on 16 decisions is 10 better / 6 equal / 0 worse. In natural games every seat arm hit the 300 s wall clock after <200 steps while the mirror finished the map in 2,079 steps, with a 50.3% takeover rate. So it can label offline data but cannot be a 1-second online policy. NOT BUILT: the tactical regression set, a bounded/cancellable kernel variant, and the 128-decision label pilot.

tasks.title: B2 search distillation ranker
tasks.blockedBy: T13-06 tactical soundness was not established. The calibrated kernel improves its OWN leaf objective but no evidence shows it does not blunder, and a leaf proxy is explicitly not a win-rate result. Generating labels for B2 before that check would distil an unqualified teacher.
tasks.notes: The branch is now better motivated than before (the shipped teacher was worth nothing; the calibrated one at least differs), so B2 should follow the tactical suite rather than replace it.

tasks.title: DAgger on student-visited states
tasks.notes: Still gated on a teacher that can be called cheaply. The kernel costs ~0.66-6 s per decision, and DAgger needs labels on student-visited states, so a bounded kernel variant is a prerequisite.

tasks.title: Value head
tasks.notes: Still 30 independent natural terminations; unchanged by this round.

productionImpact: none - model_registry.json unmodified, defaultProductionPolicy still "heuristic", battle_search_ai.ts unmodified (the calibrated config is recorded as a configuration under test, not committed)
notDoneMustNotBeReadAsDone: The tactical regression set does not exist, so the teacher's tactical soundness is UNKNOWN.
No win-rate claim is made for the calibrated teacher; every natural arm timed out.
The calibrated configuration is NOT committed to source.
B2 / B3 / T13-08 / T13-09 / T13-10 were not started.
The 128-decision label pilot was not run.
nextStepsInOrder: Build the tactical regression set from real endgame states and run it against the calibrated kernel.
Implement a bounded, cancellable kernel variant with a legal-action fallback and re-time it.
Re-measure teacher recall under the engine candidate ordering.
Run the 128-decision label pilot, check label quality, then decide on B2.
